outcome: wound pain score on postoperative day 3
postoperative wound complications within the first 4 weeks
long-term incision-related satisfaction (Patient Scar Assessment Questionnaire)
cohort: 72 patients undergoing fetal spina bifida repair
finding: While ML incisions were associated with shorter operative times compared to LT incisions, there were no significant differences in long-term incision-related satisfaction between the two groups.
